subject: Request: architecture & evidence set for SOC 2 / SIG review (Dedicated + Private)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdanthealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
Cc: Blake Turner <blake.turner@auditworks.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request — network isolation artifacts for Dedicated & Private

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Verdant's external auditor (Blake) and our internal security team need a concise package to validate network isolation and tenant separation between your Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes as part of our 2026 SOC 2 scoping. Specifically we're asking for: 

- A one-page control map tying controls to SIG/CCM and SOC 2 criteria
- Two network diagrams: a simplified consumer-facing diagram and a detailed annotated diagram showing control-plane/data-plane boundaries for Dedicated and Private installs
- Evidence of egress controls, KMS boundaries, and tenant eviction procedures (redaction ok)
- Any test logs or runbooks demonstrating tenant eviction, key rotation, and egress block lists

Could you confirm what you can share and an ETA for the bundle? We prefer SIG-format mappings where possible; CAIQ is fine as supplemental.

Attachment: Verdant-evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with auditor questions)

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Security Engineering
Verdant Health


From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, Blake Turner <blake.turner@auditworks.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request — network isolation artifacts for Dedicated & Private

Hi Samira / Blake,

Thanks — we can assemble this. Quick plan:

1) Today: confirm scope and what needs redaction (I expect we will redact IPs and internal hostnames).
2) By EOD 20 Nov: one-page control map + slim diagram (suitable for execs/auditors).
3) By 20/21 Nov: detailed annotated diagram + evidence bundle (logs, runbooks, rotation snapshots).

Initial notes on what we can provide:
- Control-to-SIG crosswalk (draft)
- Slim diagram that shows traffic flow and high-level E/W and N/S boundaries across Hosted / Dedicated / Private
- Detailed diagram that annotates KMS domains, egress proxies, tenant eviction path, and control plane endpoints
- Redaction-friendly evidence extracts for rotation and eviction tests

Kimberly / Marissa — I’ve looped you for the technical packaging and to confirm if we can provide the eviction test logs unredacted to Blake (we may need an NDA addendum).

Attachment: draft-network-diagram-slim.pdf (stub)

Would you prefer the SIG crosswalk in XLS or Google Sheet? I can do both.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference


From: Blake Turner <blake.turner@auditworks.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com, Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request — network isolation artifacts for Dedicated & Private

Tessa / Samira —

SIG preference is fine (we'll map to CCM). A few clarifications from the auditor side so we can scope evidence: 

- For Dedicated: we need annotated flow showing how customer traffic is pinned to reserved GPU pools, where KV caches persist (if at all), and what L2/L3 controls prevent cross-customer traffic.
- For Private (VPC / on-prem): show control plane authentication path, KMS handshake boundary (who owns keys), and how ephemeral compute is isolated during model loads.
- Egress control: we expect sample iptables/policy dumps and a recent egress-block test with timestamps.
- Tenant eviction: a play-by-play runbook excerpt plus logs showing eviction trigger, data scrub action, and verification.

We can accept redacted logs but need unredacted timestamps and action IDs; please state what was redacted.

If you can get the slim control map and diagrams by 20 Nov, we'll schedule a 30 min call to walk through on 22 Nov.

Thanks,
Blake
Blake Turner
Senior Auditor, AuditWorks


From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: internal-security@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Verdant evidence packaging — what we have and blockers

Tessa / Marissa — quick internal status: 

- Network diagrams: Matt in infra can produce the detailed annotated diagram by EOD 20th. He will supply a version with IPs redacted and one with minimal hostnames (for auditors under NDA).
- KMS boundaries: We have HSM/KMS diagrams and KMS policy snapshots (rotation metadata) — can export the last 6 rotation events. 
- Egress controls: firewall/policy dumps available (iptables + cloud egress lists). Need to scrub internal mgmt addresses.
- Tenant eviction logs: available but contain customer identifiers. Proposal: provide runbook excerpt + redacted logs with action IDs; provide a separate sanitized table mapping action IDs to timestamps for auditor traceability.

Open questions: 
- Do we need to include the Dedicated GPU pool placement algorithm (sensitive)? We can provide a high-level description instead.
- Is a live walkthrough acceptable instead of providing full unredacted logs? Auditor indicated they need traceability for one sample event.

I will start assembling the evidence bundle and upload to the shared Drive folder.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Architect
Redwood Inference


From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdanthealth.com>, Blake Turner <blake.turner@auditworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Delivering initial evidence: control map + slim diagram + package link

Samira / Blake —

Per plan, attached and linked is the initial package for your review: 

- control-map-onepager.pdf (one-page control map linking controls to SIG/CCM and SOC 2 criteria)
- network-diagram-slim.pdf (high-level traffic flows for Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- network-diagram-detailed.pdf (annotated — IPs redacted)
- evidence-bundle-verdant.zip (runbook excerpts, egress policy dumps, KMS rotation metadata, sanitized eviction log table)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/verdant-evidence-folder
JIRA: SEC-3122 (packaging work)

Notes / caveats: 
- IPs and hostnames in the detailed diagram are redacted for customer privacy; we provided an auditors-only view under NDA.
- Eviction logs in the bundle are redacted; we included a sanitized table that maps redaction action IDs to timestamps so auditors can validate the sequence.
- The Dedicated GPU placement algorithm is described at a high level (non-sensitive). If auditors require deeper detail, we will coordinate an NDA addendum and a live walkthrough.

Next step: can we schedule a 30 min walkthrough on Mon 22 Nov? Suggested window: 09:00-11:00 PST.

Attachment: list above

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference


From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdanthealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
Cc: Blake Turner <blake.turner@auditworks.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Delivering initial evidence: control map + slim diagram + package link

Tessa / all —

Received — thank you. I reviewed the one-pager and slim diagram; they address most of our questions. A couple of follow-ups before the walkthrough: 

- In the detailed diagram, can you call out the KMS owner (Redwood vs customer-managed) for Private deployments in a single annotated note? 
- In the eviction sanitized table, please include the verification step output (the verification hash or assertion id) so auditors can confirm deletion attempts completed.

We can do the walkthrough on Mon 22 Nov at 10:00 PST — Blake, does that work for you?

Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Security Engineering
Verdant Health
